overview.text: Cassidy sponsored legislation requiring state-regulated insurance to cover abortion medications and gender-affirming hormones at no cost. In 2024, she sponsored laws regarding interstate reproductive health (HB5239) and restraints on pregnant prisoners (HB5431). She introduced HB5521 to bar police from using facial recognition; it stalled in committee in March 2026. She also sponsored a law regarding traveling animal acts (HB4255).
